args.subject: Private Dining Reservation Request – Table for 12 on Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a table for 12 in your private dining room on Friday, May 24, 2024.

Reservation details:
- Date: Friday, May 24, 2024
- Party size: 12 guests
- Restaurant: New Asiaway, 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France

Please let me know your availability and any menu requirements or deposit terms for a group of this size. I would also be glad to discuss timing, as your lunch and dinner services are both available that day.

Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
